criteria.requirement: Implement click.delimited.DelimitedList(item_type=str,*,separator=",",min_items=0,max_items=None) as ParamType, converting one CSV-style record or preexisting list/tuple to a tuple through the pinned item ParamType. Support quoted separators, escaped double quotes and explicit empty fields; empty text is an empty list. Reject malformed quotes, multiple records, invalid separators and invalid length bounds before invoking target commands. Preserve item BadParameter context and report one-based failing item position. Verify real option parsing and multiple=True without changing existing Tuple/Choice behavior.

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
